caption:
Amazon stock rose 3.96% on Black Friday after early holiday shopping data came in strong.
Adobe said Americans spent $7.1 billion online on Thanksgiving Day, up 10.4% from last year and above its own $6.9 billion forecast. Adobe counts every US online store, not Amazon alone, but 87% of Cyber Weekend shoppers told Numerator they plan to buy on Amazon.
The next test is Cyber Monday, which Adobe forecasts at $15.1 billion.

The full why, with charts, lands Sunday for members → link in bio.

#amazon #amazonstock #blackfriday #cybermonday #techstocks

Sources: Motley Fool (Nov 27), Adobe Analytics via GuruFocus/TradingView (Nov 27), Finexus (Nov 27). Not investment advice.
